spec.description:
Autex Quietspace Panel is a discrete, high-performance acoustic treatment
engineered to absorb a minimum of 85% to 100% of sound energy. Made from 100%
thermally bonded polyester fibre, it features a compressed, impact-resistant
face and a cushioned backing designed to optimise broadband frequency
absorption. Available in thicknesses from 25mm to 100mm, it can be installed
nude or overlaid with decorative fabric to resolve severe reverberation across
walls and ceilings.
features:
Premium broadband acoustic absorption
absorbing 85% to 100% of sound energy (NRC 0.85 - 1.00)

Dual-density
construction with compressed face and cushioned absorber backing

Constructed from 100% polyester
fibre containing minimum 45% to 58% recycled PET

Group 1 fire rating
compliant with AS ISO 9705 - 2003 and AS 5637.1

Supplied with a
factory-applied protective spun-bond cover to keep panels clean during
installation

Safe, non-toxic, non-allergenic, and free from chemical binders
or formaldehyde

Can be faced with Autex Vertiface fabric overlay or custom
digital prints
Thermal insulation performance up to R1.4 (50mm)

Certified
Carbon Neutral product with third-party verified EPD and Declare Red List Free

install:
Inspect substrate ensuring it is flat, clean, dry, and free of dust, grease, or
contaminants

Acclimatise panels in the installation space for at least 24
hours prior to fitting

Maintain factory-applied spun-bond protective sheet on
panel face throughout installation

Apply recommended contact-type or
high-grab MS polymer adhesive evenly across the panel backing

Position panel
onto the wall or ceiling substrate and press firmly across the surface

Use a
roller to ensure full adhesive contact and eliminate air pockets

Peel a
corner of the protective spun-bond film and leave hanging until painting and
messy trades finish
Remove protective film completely upon project handover
selection_checklist:
Confirm required thickness based on acoustic target
(25mm for NRC 0.85; 50mm+ for NRC 1.00)

Select finish option (Nude White,
Nude Black, Nude Grey, or Vertiface fabric overlay)

Verify total wall or
ceiling dimensions to calculate panel count (1200x2400mm sheets)

Specify
suitable adhesive (contact adhesive or high-grab MS polymer)

Confirm need for
aluminium edge trims or framing profiles
accessories:
Autex Edging
Solutions (Type C profiles for 25mm panels)
limitations: Indoor use only; avoid direct water exposure or extreme humidity

Nude panels
are utilitarian; specify Vertiface fabric overlay for decorative high-traffic
areas
Do not expose to naked flames or concentrated heat sources above 80°C

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Quietspace
Panel is a high-performance acoustic wall and ceiling panel engineered with a
dual-density polyester construction comprising an impact-resistant compressed
face and a cushioned backing. Available in thicknesses from 25mm to 100mm
in 1200mm x 2400mm sheets, it absorbs between 85% and 100% of sound energy
(NRC 0.85 to 1.00). Compliant with NCC Group 1 fire requirements under AS
ISO 9705 and containing over 45% recycled PET, it provides discrete broadband
noise control in studios, auditoriums, gyms, and commercial spaces.
